name: caffeine + meclizine + pyridoxine
uses: ■ adult and children 15 years of age and older: 1 pack 30 minutes before boarding. ■ children under 15 years of age: ask a doctor
otcwarn: Ask a doctor before use if you have taking a prescription drug. When using this product ■ Do not take more than 3 pack in 24 hours ■ If you take an additional dose, take it after 4 hours or more Keep out of reach of children
